summary: Iteration 9 — Backend regression + new endpoints validation after server.py split (591 lines) and report consolidation (2 PDFs). All 24 backend tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 591 lines — under the 700-line target. Good. Routers are well separated under /app/backend/routers/.
settings.py: logo size hard cap at 1 MB (good for Mongo doc size). content_type check uses startswith('image/') which is appropriate.
reports.py: _decode_logo wraps base64 decode in try/except → safe fallback if logo is malformed (so PDF gen never 500s on bad logo). Good defensive coding.
reports.py: chrome callback (header band + footer) is applied via onFirstPage+onLaterPages — page numbers and timestamps appear on every page as required.
Reports endpoint correctly returns 404 for unknown report_id and 400 for non-pdf fmt — matches spec.
Auth uses HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) — unauthenticated calls return 403 not 401 for some routes; not blocking, but consider standardizing to 401 for missing token.
seed_data_creation: Test created and deleted one transient property (TEST_PropIter9). Settings PUT updated nome_societa='Acme RE SRL' and target_netto=7 on the CEO's settings doc — kept (not reverted) because endpoint contract validation required it. Logo uploaded then cleared by DELETE /api/settings/logo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints (auth, properties, deals, watchlists, ai/deal-analyze, imports for immobili/bilanci/banca, new /api/settings + /api/settings/logo, and new /api/report/{stato-salute|business-plan}.pdf) verified end-to-end. Logo round-trip through PDF generation works (PDF still returns 200 with embedded base64 PNG). /api/import/bilanci/storico returns {bilanci:[], evoluzione:[]} (dict, not list). Note: PUT /api/settings on the ceo user has lasting effect — nome_societa is now 'Acme RE SRL' and target_netto=7 on the demo account.
rca_of_the_issue: No issues found. Initial test failure was a wrong client-side assumption about /api/import/bilanci/storico response shape (it returns a dict, not a list). Test was corrected; endpoint is working as intended.
